name: Admin Authentication and Dashboard Navigation
description: An admin logs in with valid credentials, is redirected to the home dashboard, and then navigates to the Clients view to verify that client records are visible.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the application login page
If a warning, reminder, or interstitial page appears with a button to continue (such as Click to Continue or Continue to Site), click that button to proceed to the application
Enter admin@quantira.com into the email address input field
Enter admin123 into the password input field
Verify that the page title or main heading matches Dashboard
Click the Clients sidebar navigation link
Verify that the clients table or list is visible and contains a row with text QA E2E Client
